description.zh: 使用这个来进行灰度判断
description.en: The version of the API.

description.zh: oss的桶筛选
description.en: The name of the OSS bucket.

description.zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值：1。
description.en: The page number of the returned page. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 数据库名筛选
description.en: The name of the database.

description.zh: 数据资产所属的数据域ID。
description.en: The ID of the data domain to which the data asset belongs.

description.zh: 此参数已废弃。
description.en: This parameter is deprecated.

description.zh: 文件分类编码。
description.en: The code of the file category.

description.zh:
支持识别的OSS文件类型。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeDocTypes](~~2536492~~)获取支持识别的OSS文件类型，取返回值中的Code字段值，本参数仅对OSS类型的资产查询有效。
description.en:
The type of the OSS file.

> This parameter is valid only for querying data assets of the OSS type. You can call the [DescribeDocTypes](~~2536492~~) operation to obtain the supported OSS file types. Use the value of the `Code` parameter in the response.

description.zh: 资产实例ID关键字。
description.en: The keyword of the instance ID.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh_cn**。取值：
- **zh_cn**：中文。
- **en_us**：英文。
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh\_cn**. Valid values:

- **zh\_cn**: Chinese.

- **en\_us**: English.

description.zh: sls的logstore筛选
description.en: The name of the Logstore.

description.zh: 数据目录的sls页面有两层，需要用这个进行判断，是查找的logstore维度数据
description.en: Specifies whether to query data at the Logstore level. The Simple Log Service data catalog has two layers. Set this parameter to 1 to query data at the Logstore level.

description.zh: 成员账号ID。
description.en: The ID of the member.

description.zh:
行业模板的模型ID，多个ID通过逗号分隔。
> 您可以通过调用[DescribeTemplateAllRules](~~2536491~~)获取行业模板模型标识ID。
description.en:
The model ID of the industry-specific rule template. You can specify multiple IDs. Separate them with commas (,).

> You can call the [DescribeTemplateAllRules](~~2536491~~) operation to obtain the model ID of the industry-specific rule template.

description.zh:
待查询的数据标签，多个用逗号分隔。取值：
- **101**：个人敏感信息。
- **102**：个人信息。
- **107**：通用信息。
description.en:
The data labels to be queried. You can specify multiple data labels. Separate them with commas (,). Valid values:

- **101**: personal sensitive information

- **102**: personal information

- **107**: general information

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置列表中每页显示的数据资产实例的最大条数。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of data assets to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

description.zh: 待查询模板的父分类列表，多个父分类ID用逗号分隔。
description.en: The IDs of the parent asset categories to be queried. You can specify multiple IDs. Separate them with commas (,).

description.zh: 文件路径筛选
description.en: The path of the file.

description.zh: 数据目录的产品
description.en: The ID of the product.

description.zh:
建议填写，待查询的产品ID列表，多个用逗号分隔。取值：
- **1**：MaxCompute
- **2**：OSS
- **3**：ADB-MYSQL
- **4**：TableStore
- **5**：RDS
- **6**：SELF_DB
- **7**：PolarDB-X
- **8**：PolarDB
- **9**：ADB-PG
- **10**：OceanBase
- **11**：MongoDB
- **25**：Redis

> OSS与其他产品互斥，即如果待查询中有OSS，则不能有其他产品列表；默认查询的为非OSS产品。
description.en:
The IDs of the products to which the data assets to be queried belong. You can specify multiple product IDs. Separate them with commas (,). We recommend that you specify this parameter. Valid values:

- **1**: MaxCompute

- **2**: OSS

- **3**: ADB-MYSQL

- **4**: TableStore

- **5**: RDS

- **6**: SELF\_DB

- **7**: PolarDB-X

- **8**: PolarDB

- **9**: ADB-PG

- **10**: OceanBase

- **11**: MongoDB

- **25**: Redis

> If you want to query data assets that belong to OSS, you cannot query data assets of other products. By default, data assets of products other than OSS are queried.

description.zh: SLS的project筛选
description.en: The name of the Simple Log Service project.

description.zh: 待查询的数据对象关键字。
description.en: The keyword of the data asset to be queried.

description.zh: 数据目录展示页的区域
description.en: The region in which the data asset catalog resides.

description.zh: 分级筛选
description.en: The IDs of the sensitivity levels. You can specify multiple sensitivity level IDs. Separate them with commas (,).

description.zh:
指定要查询的数据资产的风险等级，存在多个时使用英文逗号（,）隔开。
- **2**：S1，弱风险等级。
- **3**：S2，中等风险等级。
- **4**：S3，高风险等级。
- **5**：S4，最高风险等级。
description.en:
The sensitivity level of the data asset. You can specify multiple sensitivity levels. Separate them with commas (,).

- **2**: S1, low sensitivity level

- **3**: S2, medium sensitivity level

- **4**: S3, high sensitivity level

- **5**: S4, highest sensitivity level

description.zh: 规则筛选
description.en: The IDs of the rules. You can specify multiple rule IDs. Separate them with commas (,).

description.zh:
资产所在的地域。取值：
- **cn-beijing**：华北2（北京）。
- **cn-zhangjiakou**：华北3（张家口）。
- **cn-huhehaote**：华北5（呼和浩特）。
- **cn-hangzhou**：华东1（杭州）。
- **cn-shanghai**：华东2（上海）。
- **cn-shenzhen**：华南1（深圳）。
- **cn-hongkong**：中国香港。
description.en:
The region where the data asset resides. Valid values:

- **cn-beijing**: China (Beijing)

- **cn-zhangjiakou**: China (Zhangjiakou)

- **cn-huhehaote**: China (Hohhot)

- **cn-hangzhou**: China (Hangzhou)

- **cn-shanghai**: China (Shanghai)

- **cn-shenzhen**: China (Shenzhen)

- **cn-hongkong**: China (Hong Kong)

description.zh: 任务名筛选
description.en: The name of the table.

description.zh: 任务Id筛选
description.en: The ID of the task.

description.zh:
行业模版ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeCategoryTemplateList](~~2399296~~)获取行业模板标识ID。
description.en:
The ID of the industry-specific rule template.

> You can call the [DescribeCategoryTemplateList](~~2399296~~) operation to obtain the ID of the industry-specific rule template.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于查询数据表、文件的识别结果，便于从全局视角查询资产的数据识别结果。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation queries data detection results for tables and files, to provide a comprehensive view across all your assets.

## QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 requests per second. If you exceed this limit, the system throttles your API calls. To prevent business disruptions, call this operation only when necessary.
